zephyr-client-fixed.built_as: the fixed-memory client of overlays/t2g_client_fixed.conf with the idle wait and batching off (main stack 9216 bytes), its node wz_session_mcu::slot_node
zephyr-client-fixed.measured: 2026-10-23, the T2G kit (CYT4BF M7) on its own Ethernet to a zenohd on the bench host; the stack line is the same in 7 of 7 runs, the GET figure is the median of 14 medians (0.320 to 0.471 ms) of 2000 queries for each of the node's two documents

zephyr-client-fixed-batching.built_as: the fixed-memory client of overlays/t2g_client_batching.conf with one send window sent as one datagram, the idle wait off (main stack 10240 bytes), its node wz_session_mcu::slot_node
zephyr-client-fixed-batching.measured: 2026-10-23, the T2G kit (CYT4BF M7) on its own Ethernet to a zenohd on the bench host; the stack line is the same in 3 of 3 runs, the GET figure is the median of 6 medians (0.287 to 0.462 ms) of 2000 queries for each of the node's two documents

zephyr-client-fixed-get.built_as: the fixed-memory client of overlays/t2g_client_get.conf, which also asks one query at a time (two pending rows), the idle wait and batching off (main stack 12288 bytes); its node is wz_session_mcu::slot_node and its getter wz_session_mcu::slot_getter
zephyr-client-fixed-get.chain_misses: the reply sink and the reply view are called through a register (12 such calls on the path of the chain), which the stack gate's reader does not follow; the firmware's own reading is 472 bytes over the chain
zephyr-client-fixed-get.measured: 2026-10-23, the T2G kit (CYT4BF M7) asking a responder on the bench host, a client of a zenohd there, for a document of 165 bytes, 2050 queries with 50 of warm-up; the stack line and the getter's median (300 us, p99 1300 to 1400 us) are the same in 8 of 8 clean runs; the kernel tick is 100 us, so the median has that resolution
